summary: The engine now forces a piece reinstall when requiring it fails. Piece installation no longer depends on the worker being able to reach the public URL.
Version 0.91.1 includes fixes for subflow retries and connection references. The build fix moves MinIO off Docker Hub and removes source maps that the image build deletes.

Added agent capabilities, including running saved agents from flow steps, configuring agents alongside their workflows, and recording agent actions in audit logs. Updates also add and improve integrations such as Gmail, Sage Accounting, WhatsScale, and Ninety, while fixing issues across agents, flows, workers, and integrations—including GET request handling, OAuth connections, and Stripe customer search.

Template-expression evaluation and the shared script session now use the legacy sandbox instead of spawning a Deno process for each token. This reduces memory pressure and slowdowns when flows map many expressions over large step outputs.

summary: Existing workflows can now be edited with natural-language instructions using AI in the workflow builder, including whole-workflow changes, code-step updates, and help debugging execution errors.
